import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD2 = 1000000007L;

    static long counter = 0;
    static long n_limit;
    static long low_sum = 0;
    static long total = 0;
    static long[] pwr_array = new long[8];
    static List<Integer>[] num_vectors = new ArrayList[7];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            num_vectors[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generate_numbers(int depth, long val) {
        long temp = (counter + MOD1 - val % MOD1) % MOD1;
        num_vectors[depth].add((int) temp);
        low_sum = (low_sum + temp) % MOD2;
        counter++;
        if (depth < 6) {
            for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
                generate_numbers(depth + 1, val * 10 + digit);
            }
        }
    }

    static void compute_results(int depth, long x) {
        if (x > n_limit) return;
        int i;
        if (x * pwr_array[6] + pwr_array[6] - 1 <= n_limit && x * pwr_array[7] > n_limit) {
            for (i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long delta = (counter + (MOD1 - pwr_array[i]) * x) % MOD1;
                long idx = lowerBound(num_vectors[i], (int) (MOD1 - delta));
                long add_value = ((delta + MOD2 - MOD1) % MOD1) * pwr_array[i] + MOD1 * idx;
                total = (total + add_value) % MOD2;
            }
            total = (total + low_sum) % MOD2;
            counter += 1111111;
            return;
        }
        long add_total = (counter + (MOD1 - x % MOD1)) % MOD1;
        total = (total + add_total) % MOD2;
        counter++;
        int startDigit = (depth != 0) ? 0 : 1;
        for (i = startDigit; i < 10; i++) {
            compute_results(depth + 1, x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static long lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        pwr_array[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 7; i++) {
            pwr_array[i] = pwr_array[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        generate_numbers(0, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(num_vectors[i]);
        }
        n_limit = sc.nextLong();
        counter = 0;
        total = 0;
        low_sum = 0;
        compute_results(0, 0);
        System.out.println(total);
        sc.close();
    }
}
